mapper.insert: insert into ssm_analysis_tpl_visit_log ( analysis_tpl_id, portal_id, visit_type, resource_version, user_name, visit_begin_time, visit_end_time ) values ( #{analysisTplId}, #{portalId}, #{visitType}, #{resourceVersion}, #{userName}, #{visitBeginTime}, #{visitEndTime} )
mapper.select: select t.analysis_tpl_id as analysisTplId, t.portal_id as portalId, date_format(max(t.visit_begin_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastVisitTime, b.analysis_tpl_name as analysisTplName, b.analysis_tpl_type as analysisTplType from ssm_analysis_tpl_visit_log t inner join ssm_analysis_tpl_base b on t.analysis_tpl_id = b.analysis_tpl_id where t.user_name = #{userName} and (t.visit_type is null or t.visit_type = 'analysis_template') and b.is_active = 1 group by t.analysis_tpl_id, t.portal_id, b.analysis_tpl_name, b.analysis_tpl_type order by lastVisitTime desc limit #{limit}
